summary: Carter Bankshares, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share declared by its board of directors. The dividend is payable on May 25, 2026 to shareholders of record as of May 11, 2026, representing a 1.64% annualized yield based on the April 21 closing price of $24.44. This is a routine capital allocation event with no structural change, no tender offer, no special-committee involvement, and no strategic pivot. The filing serves as public notice of a regular dividend declaration. No special-situation elements are present; this is a standard current report of an ordinary dividend.
